rule: Each Reel uses a different bed from the previous two Reels by queue date (all series and companions). Record it in the queue file as "music".

piano.style: calm felt piano and pads, ~70 BPM

guitar.style: fingerpicked acoustic guitar and upright bass, ~85 BPM

ambient.style: soft ambient electronic, pads and muted pulse, ~90 BPM

voice_rule: Never the same voice on three Reels in a row by queue date. Record it as "voice".
